hintConnectionText: The adapter delivers the daily figures to the Abrechnung Mailcarrier web application over HTTPS. The API URL and the token come from the client administration of the web application (page Mandanten).
apiUrlHelp: Address of the API, ending in /api/v1. Must start with https://.
apiTokenHelp: Starts with abrk_. It belongs to exactly one client and is shown only once when it is created; a new one can be created and the old one revoked at any time.
sourceType: Where do the figures come from?
sourceTypeHelp: iobroker.solarlog computes the split itself and keeps a local journal. With energy states the split is computed here from counters of other adapters.
sourceCounters: Energy states of other adapters (e.g. Shelly, inverter)
journalStateIdHelp: State of the solarlog adapter that holds the daily journal (default solarlog.0.Database.dailyJournal).
snapshotTimeHelp: Time of day when the readings are taken and the day is closed (default 23:58).
staleMinutesHelp: A reading older than this at day closing marks the day as outdated.
metersTableHelp: One row per apartment: the name as it appears in the billing (e.g. WHG 1) and the energy state of its meter.
productionTableHelp: Energy states of the production of all inverters. They are added up.
feedinTableHelp: If a feed-in meter exists, the self-consumption is production minus feed-in. Without it, the smaller of production and total consumption is used.
snapshotTimeInvalid: Please enter a time as HH:MM.
